selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy segment before isolation (node1<->node2<->node3 subnet reachability)
selected_evidence.summary: Static IPs assigned on the shared 192.168.50.0/24 segment (node1 eth1 .1, node2 enp8s0 .11, node3 enp8s0 .12); full-mesh ping succeeded in all directions before any isolation rule existed.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 cannot exchange traffic directly
selected_evidence.summary: Persistent firewalld rich-rule drops added on node2 (source 192.168.50.12) and node3 (source 192.168.50.11); post-rule ICMP between node2 and node3 fails 100% both directions, and a raw TCP connect attempt from node2 to node3:22 times out (no RST), confirming protocol-agnostic drop.

selected_evidence.requirement: Both node2 and node3 continue to reach node1 on the shared subnet
selected_evidence.summary: node2->node1 and node3->node1 ICMP succeed with 0% loss after the isolation rules were applied; node1->node2 and node1->node3 also succeed.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 7223d5b7...; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-boot boot_id changed to 00c2c9bd...; recovered state shows enp8s0 IP retained, firewalld rich rule intact, node2->node1 reachable and node2->node3 still blocked.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e625b9a5...; reboot acknowledged; post-boot boot_id changed to b62a6aa5...; recovered state shows enp8s0 IP retained, firewalld rich rule intact, node3->node1 reachable and node3->node2 still blocked.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 (SONiC) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state including cluster membership/services
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4aba45d4...; reboot acknowledged; polled through downtime until boot_id changed to 688a02fd...; recovered state confirms eth1 static IP persisted via /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth1, all SONiC docker containers (database, swss, bgp, syncd, teamd, sysmgr, eventd, radv, gbsyncd) back up healthy, and node1 reaches both node2 and node3.

selected_evidence.requirement: Final cluster-wide state after all three restarts: isolation and reachability both still correct
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart full recheck: node1<->node2 and node1<->node3 both reachable; node2<->node3 still 100% blocked in both directions, confirming persistence of the port-isolation configuration across a full reboot cycle of all three nodes.
